title: Material Selection Chart
publisher: Milton Roy Company, Flow Control Division
source_scope: General aid for selecting materials of construction for flow-control equipment handling aggressive fluids.
source_disclaimer: The source states that the chart is a general aid and does not constitute a guarantee.

extraction_method: Coordinate-based extraction from the PDF text layer, with page-image inspection of table headings, special symbols, notes and packing tables.
